claim: For an integral scheme covered by two affine opens, original overlap regular functions surject additively onto the original global H1 of its structure sheaf; this holds for the exact full finite/infinity cover of the original contact source.

obligations.name: Original local cohomology generators
obligations.required: Interpret the actual pinned-library H-prime groups, not a newly defined Cech model.
obligations.constructed: generator U is the sheafification of the free-abelian representable presheaf at U, exactly the coefficient generator in Mathlib Sheaf.H-prime.
obligations.justification: sectionLift and presheafEquiv explicitly evaluate the generator at the identity restriction. Free-abelian universal properties and original sheafification adjunction prove a natural section equivalence.

obligations.name: Degree-zero section comparison
obligations.required: Retain the additive groups of actual original sections.
obligations.constructed: Ext.addEquiv-zero followed by additive sheafification adjunction and generator evaluation gives zeroAddEquiv.
obligations.justification: The separate additive map structure is proved, not inferred from an arbitrary equivalence. Coefficient naturality is proved with original Ext composition.

obligations.name: Local affine H1 vanishing
obligations.required: Prove local H-prime-one vanishing for the original global structure sheaf on actual affine opens.
obligations.constructed: LocalAffineStructureHOne318.eq_zero applies the predecessor arbitrary O-kernel section-lifting result to the actual injective embedding and cokernel.
obligations.justification: Every Ext1 class is a connecting image; the corresponding degree-zero section lifts on the affine open, so exactness kills its boundary. Empty opens are included by the exact predecessor theorem. No local/global or Cech comparison is assumed.

obligations.name: Terminal generator comparison
obligations.required: Bind local top-open cohomology to the original global cohomology definition.
obligations.constructed: The free-abelian generator at top and original constant integer sheaf both corepresent original global sections.
obligations.justification: Uniqueness of representing objects supplies their actual isomorphism. Explicit Ext precomposition along its inverse and forward maps gives a two-sided additive equivalence H-prime-n(top) to the unchanged global H-n.

obligations.name: Actual two-open Mayer-Vietoris square
obligations.required: Use the genuine topology and a full cover, not a conditional exactness premise.
obligations.constructed: square U V is the actual opens-poset square with intersection, U, V and top.
obligations.justification: Its pullback property is proved by the infimum universal property. The two arrows form a covering sieve from U union V equals top. Mathlib then derives the free-sheaf short exact sequence.

obligations.name: Derived boundary and surjectivity
obligations.required: Construct the connecting map from genuine derived cohomology.
obligations.constructed: boundary composes the original Mayer-Vietoris delta with the proved terminal equivalence.
obligations.justification: Ext exactness gives preimages because both affine local H1 groups vanish. The argument uses the biproduct Ext equivalence, not a replacement of the target H1 carrier.

obligations.name: Actual overlap sections
obligations.required: Supply an actual additive map from original functions to original global H1.
obligations.constructed: AffineCoverHOnePresentation318.boundary composes the inverse actual degree-zero section equivalence with the derived boundary.
obligations.justification: For any integral scheme and two affine opens covering it, this map is surjective. No finite-dimensionality or a choice of artificial H1 coordinates is introduced.

obligations.name: Original contact source consumer
obligations.required: Keep the original common source, its actual finite chart and its actual infinity chart.
obligations.constructed: ActualSourceHOnePresentation318 uses SourceGlobalAffine318.chartEmbedding and InfinityGlobalScheme318.chartEmbedding and the previously proved full cover.
obligations.justification: Their actual opens are affine; source integrality is the original model theorem. The resulting map from original overlap functions targets exactly the same SourceHOne used by all five quotient pullbacks.

obligations.name: Scope and remaining spanning work
obligations.required: Do not turn an overlap-section presentation into fivefold spanning or duality.
obligations.constructed: This packet proves a genuine surjective additive boundary from original overlap sections to original H1.
obligations.justification: It does not yet identify its kernel with an explicit difference of ring restrictions, compute the overlap quotient, prove dimension five or fivefold pullback spanning, or identify Picard tangent/Serre duality/Jacobian maps. The rational scalar continuation is separate and not imported.
